description.from:
Replace the merged `scannedFiles` list with per-layer coverage and a reasoned outcome per evidence path.

`scanRepoByManifestLayers` currently pushes orchestrator `files` and personal-data `filesScanned` into one array. A component case is therefore eligible because the PII matcher opened the file, even though the graph pass never parsed it — and it fails in the direction that inflates recall. This is a correctness fix, not a precision improvement.

Outcomes: successfully evaluated, unsupported, excluded, `cap_exceeded`, missing, read/parse error. Only successfully evaluated evidence enters recall or negative denominators.

Related defect in the same function: when only personal-data layers are requested, `scannedFiles` is taken from whichever payload happened to be first (`payloadMentions ?? payloadRaw ?? payloadItems`).

Repository-level entities need an explicit rule: an entity is eligible when at least one supporting evidence path is in that layer's successful ledger, and ineligible-reason counts are per entity, not per location.

Startable now — independent of the gate rulings.

title.from: Per-layer coverage ledger with reasoned outcomes
